name: Service Requests, RFCs, Device References, Ticket Relationships
foundation_dependencies: LLD-02 Customer/Contact/Local User Profile identity and matching interfaces
scope: RFC exact identity and accepted current source/lifecycle projection
operational Device Reference identity and SR/RFC links
Working Notes with immutable creator provenance
not_owned_here: RFC/WFM workbook discovery/parsing/staging/immutable source observations and vocabulary -> LLD-04
Network Element/Device Reference regularization target -> LLD-08
Communication evidence/links/retention and cascade consequences -> LLD-09
frontend components and deliberate-interaction rendering -> LLD-10
transaction_boundaries: Workbook/source parsing, normalization, previews and expensive diff work occur outside writer transactions under owning LLDs.
Every LLD-03 authoritative mutation uses one short LLD-01 BEGIN IMMEDIATE UnitOfWork with idempotency receipt, owned mutation and required audit committed atomically.
Terminal RFC source acceptance and creation/supersession of its pending cascade proposal are one transaction but execute no downstream cascade.
Terminal-cascade execution revalidates exact scope and invokes LLD-05/LLD-09 participants inside the same UnitOfWork; participants never commit independently.
Archive/operation membership/events and RFC archive-state changes are atomic; hard-delete receipt/audit/delete are atomic and unexpected FKs fail closed.
failure_modes: typed domain failures are defined in errors.json and inherit LLD-01 transport/idempotency/stale/persistence failures
stale relationship/cascade/archive/delete previews fail closed and require refreshed exact state
INDETERMINATE cross-domain lifecycle/delete dependencies block destructive or cascade action
crash and participant half-commit behavior is explicitly covered by tests/rfc-lifecycle-failure-injection.json
construction_evidence: all six required packet directories populated and exact packet file set pinned
LSR allocator reaches LSR-99999999 and fails cleanly only at explicit exhausted sentinel
working-note creator identity is directly preserved
RFC source/lifecycle current projection is separate from immutable import evidence and duplicate identity-row source authority removed
terminal RFC evidence atomically creates restart-persistent exact-scope cascade proposal without executing consequences
cascade uses same-UoW bounded Task/Objective and Communication participant interfaces with stale/deliberate-confirmation guards
archive/restore provenance is operation-scoped and ordered by RFC revision rather than timestamp ties
hard deletion has explicit preview/freshness/audit/FK fail-closed semantics
FK/index and STRICT-schema obligations are explicitly represented
happy-path, edge, stale, crash and partial-participant failure vectors are explicit
design_principle: Ticket identity and relationship history survive source adoption, hierarchy correction, terminal state, archival and regularization; current source/lifecycle projections are rebuildable, irreversible evidence remains with its owner, and cross-domain consequences occur only through bounded history-preserving same-transaction interfaces.
